products.productName: Stitch Log: Needlepoint Project Journal & Canvas Stash Tracker
products.superPrompt:
You are a stationery designer who understands needlepoint. Produce the complete interior for a stylish needlepoint project journal and canvas stash log.

BUYER AND JOB
Newer needlepoint stitchers (mostly Gen Z and younger millennial women) whose canvas and thread stash is outgrowing their memory, plus friends buying them a gift. Job: one place for every canvas (designer, size, mesh, kitted, price), every thread by brand and color number, project notes, what is at the finisher and when it's due back, and 2027 goals. Apps exist; this is for stitchers who prefer paper.

DELIVERABLES (same content, two builds)
A) KDP paperback interior: 6 x 9 in, no bleed, exactly 120 pages, inside margin 0.75 in, other margins 0.5 in, black ink only (patterns rendered in grays).
B) Printable PDF: US Letter and A4, portrait, 0.5 in (13 mm) margins, full color, plus a "print extra" pack (one inventory page, one thread page, one 3-page project set, one finisher page).

PAGE LIST (KDP numbering)
1 Title: "[YOUR SHOP NAME] Stitch Log: Needlepoint Project Journal & Canvas Stash Tracker", "This stash belongs to ____".
2 How to use (max 120 words) and a glossary: mesh count, kitted, stitch guide, tent stitch (continental, basketweave), finisher, self-finishing, stash. One accurate sentence each; no invented history or statistics.
3 2027 stitch goals: goal lines, "canvases I will finish", "techniques I want to try" (blank), Jan-Dec finish boxes to color in.
4-5 Year at a glance: month | started | finished | sent to finisher | back from finisher.
6-17 Canvas inventory as 6 two-page spreads, 12 rows each (72 canvases). Left page: # | canvas name | designer | size (in) | mesh. Right page: kitted Y/N | stitch guide Y/N | price | where/when bought | status (stash / WIP / done / at finisher).
18-27 Thread stash, 18 rows per page: fiber (wool, cotton, silk, metallic, blend) | brand | color number | color name | qty | for which canvas | reorder checkbox.
28-29 Wish list (canvas, designer, shop, price, priority) and shopping list.
30-89 Twenty project sets x 3 pages: (a) overview: canvas, designer, size, mesh, start, target finish, finishing-plan checkboxes (ornament, pillow, stocking, framed, insert, self-finish, undecided), thread table (color number | fiber | used for | qty) x 14 rows; (b) stitch notes: area | stitch | thread | notes x 12 rows, 2 x 2 in sketch box; (c) progress: date | time | area worked x 12 rows, "finished on", "what I learned".
90-93 Finisher tracker, 12 rows per page: piece | finisher | finishing type | date sent | finisher's cutoff or quote date | quoted cost | expected back | received checkbox.
94-95 Holiday finishing planner: piece | stitching done by | send-by date (from my finisher) | gift for | status; note "Ask your finisher for their holiday cutoff."
96-99 Stitch-night and shop log: date | where / with whom | worked on | notes.
100-101 Chart-your-own grids at true scale: 13 squares per inch and 18 squares per inch.
102-103 Year-in-review prompts.
104-120 Dot-grid notes.

DESIGN
Preppy-modern. Palette "Stitch Club": Cream #FBF6EE, Bow Pink #F4B6C2, Kelly #2F8F5B, Cobalt #2E4F9E, Ink #2A2A33. Fonts: DM Serif Display (headings), Montserrat (body 9.5-10.5 pt, table labels 8 pt caps). Motifs: original gingham borders, bows, scissors, needle and thread, scalloped headers. KDP interior converts the palette to grays. Rows at least 0.28 in tall.

CONTENT RULES
Original wording, warm and a little witty, grade 7 reading level. Leave brand, designer and color columns blank: print no thread-brand names, color charts, designer names or shop names. No reproductions of hand-painted canvas designs or paid stitch guides. No claims about stress, anxiety, mental health or other benefits. No celebrity names.

DIFFERENTIATION
Cross-stitch planners track fabric count and floss. This journal follows the needlepoint workflow (mesh, kitted status, stitch guides, finishers, holiday finishing dates), styled for a younger, preppy audience.

OUTPUT FORMAT
1) KDP page table: page | title | elements | columns | rows | layout notes. 2) Printable differences (orientation, color, print-extra pack). 3) Final text for pages 1-3, 94-95 and 102-103, plus a 120-word back-cover blurb with no claims. 4) Repeat map of master pages.
Self-check, fixing failures before answering: [ ] exactly 120 KDP pages; [ ] inventory spreads hold 72 canvases; [ ] all brand, designer and color fields blank; [ ] glossary accurate and simple; [ ] no benefit claims; [ ] Letter and A4 both specified.

imagePrompts.purpose: Front cover for the KDP paperback and Etsy thumbnail
imagePrompts.prompt: Preppy-modern journal cover, portrait 2:3, at least 1800 x 2700 px. Bow Pink #F4B6C2 and Cream #FBF6EE gingham background; a centered Cream scalloped label framed in Kelly #2F8F5B, topped with an original illustrated Cobalt #2E4F9E bow; a threaded needle draws a looping thread around the label. Flat vector, crisp edges. Render this text exactly in an elegant high-contrast serif: "Stitch Log"; beneath it in small caps sans-serif: "NEEDLEPOINT PROJECT JOURNAL & CANVAS STASH TRACKER". Negatives: no painted canvas designs, no designer artwork, no brand names, no logos, no real people, no trademarked characters, no watermarks, no other text. If letters render wrong, regenerate without text and set type in Canva (DM Serif Display + Montserrat).

imagePrompts.purpose: Decorative motif set for page headers
imagePrompts.prompt: Set of 12 small original decorative motifs on a transparent background, 1:1, 2048 x 2048 px, even grid: bow, embroidery scissors, threaded needle, thread skein with a blank band, pincushion, a square of blank needlepoint mesh, small stocking outline, round ornament outline, heart, scallop border piece, thimble, star. Flat vector, consistent 4 px Ink #2A2A33 outline, fills in Bow Pink #F4B6C2, Kelly #2F8F5B and Cobalt #2E4F9E. No text, no brand labels, no painted canvas designs, no logos, no real people, no trademarked characters, no watermarks.

Photorealistic flat-lay, 4:5 portrait, on a cream linen tablecloth: an open printed journal with blank pages, a blank unpainted needlepoint canvas on stretcher bars, three unlabeled thread skeins in pink, green and blue, small gold scissors and a cup of tea. Soft morning light. Leave the journal pages blank for overlay in Canva. No painted designs on the canvas, no brand labels, no people, no hands, no text, no logos, no trademarked characters, no watermarks.

assembly: Before building (15 minutes): search Etsy for 'needlepoint journal' and 'needlepoint stash tracker' and note how many needlepoint-specific (not cross-stitch) results appear and their price range. Proceed unless the first pages are full of near-identical products.
Run the super prompt. In Canva create a 6 x 9 in design (KDP) and an 8.5 x 11 in design (printable); add margin guides (0.75 in gutter and 0.5 in elsewhere for KDP; 0.5 in all round for Letter).

Build one master of each repeating page (inventory spread, thread page, 3-page project set, finisher page, dot grid) using Canva tables, the gingham tile and motifs; duplicate per the repeat map until KDP has exactly 120 pages. Keep the KDP file grayscale.
Build the 13- and 18-squares-per-inch chart grids at true scale, print one test page at 100% and measure with a ruler.

Export PDF Print (Flatten PDF on, no crop marks). Duplicate and resize the printable to A4 (210 x 297 mm) and export, then export the print-extra pack. Keep each file under Etsy's 20 MB limit (verify).

Etsy listing images at least 2000 px wide: cover mockup, inventory spread, thread stash page, project set, finisher tracker, 'what's inside' grid and a sizes/formats graphic. No designer canvases may appear in any photo.

List the printable at $8. Only after the Dec 10 check passes: download KDP's cover template for 6 x 9 in, 120 pages, white paper, build the wrap in Canva, export PDF Print, upload as a paperback (black & white interior, no bleed) and order a proof.

1. A title under 140 characters starting with "Needlepoint Journal Printable" or "Needlepoint Stash Tracker", then canvas inventory, thread log, finisher tracker, gift for stitchers. Show the count.
2. Exactly 13 tags of 20 characters or fewer, with counts (ideas: needlepoint journal, needlepoint gift, canvas stash log, stitch tracker, needlepoint planner, thread inventory, finishing tracker, stitching gift, craft journal, project tracker, preppy printable, hobby planner, stitch log).

products.superPrompt:
You are a party-printables designer and playful copywriter. Produce a complete, print-ready stitch-night host kit for needlepoint gatherings.

BUYER AND JOB
Hosts of home or shop stitch nights: friends who meet to stitch canvases, show their projects, swap canvases and snack. Job: make inviting, welcoming and swapping easy so the night feels like a club. Built for needlepoint specifically (canvas swaps, project cards with mesh and finishing plans), not a generic party set.

DELIVERABLES (each piece in a US Letter 8.5 x 11 in and an A4 210 x 297 mm layout, 0.25 in / 6 mm printer-safe margin, light dashed 0.5 pt cut lines)
1. Invitation, 5 x 7 in (127 x 178 mm), 2 per landscape page. Three wording versions: cozy, preppy-witty, holiday canvas swap. Fields: date, time, place, host, RSVP, "bring" line.
2. Sign-in sheet, full portrait page: name | contact or handle | what I'm stitching | open to swaps? Y/N, 20 rows.
3. Name tags, 3.375 x 2.333 in (86 x 59 mm), 8 per portrait page: "Hello, I'm ____ / Currently stitching ____". Two designs.
4. "What I'm stitching" cards, 3.5 x 5 in (89 x 127 mm), 4 per portrait page: canvas name, designer, mesh, stitches I'm trying, finishing plan, "ask me about".
5. Canvas-swap tickets, 1.75 x 5 in (44 x 127 mm) including a 1.25 in (32 mm) stub, 8 per landscape page: "No. ____", canvas size and mesh lines on the ticket, name and number on the stub.
6. Swap rules card, 5 x 7 in, 2 per landscape page: 6 original, fair, friendly rules (how tickets are drawn, label size and mesh, trade one for one, leave with what you brought if there's no match).
7. Snack and drink menu, 3.75 x 9 in (95 x 229 mm), 2 per portrait page: 4 snack and 4 drink lines with original stitching-pun names (no brand names), plus a blank version.
8. Host checklist page: before, during, after (good lighting, scissors, magnifier, spare needles, a bag for thread ends, music), all generic.
9. Table sign, 5 x 7 in: "Stitch Night", plus a "Swap Table" variant.

DESIGN
Palette "Stitch Club": Cream #FBF6EE, Bow Pink #F4B6C2, Kelly #2F8F5B, Cobalt #2E4F9E, Ink #2A2A33. Fonts: DM Serif Display headings, Montserrat body, Dancing Script for at most one accent word per piece. Motifs: original gingham borders, bows, scissors, needle and thread, scalloped edges. Every piece must also read well printed in black and white.

CONTENT RULES
Original copy, playful but not cheesy, grade 6-7 reading level. No designer canvas art or paid stitch-guide content, no thread, snack or drink brand names, no celebrity names, no song lyrics. Leave designer fields blank. Any alcohol mention stays generic ("something bubbly").

DIFFERENTIATION
Generic party printables have no swap tickets, project cards or fair swap system. This kit follows how stitch nights actually run: bring a project, show it off, trade canvases.

OUTPUT FORMAT
For each piece: name | finished size | per-page layout for Letter and for A4 | exact text for every line (all versions) | layout and motif notes | color callouts. Then a short Canva build note listing which pieces share a master.
Self-check, fixing failures before answering: [ ] 9 pieces, each with Letter and A4 layouts that fit inside the margins; [ ] all text original; [ ] no brand, designer or celebrity names; [ ] swap rules clear and fair; [ ] cut lines specified.

Flat vector, clean edges. No other text, no logos, no brand names, no real people, no trademarked characters, no watermarks.

Photorealistic overhead view, 4:3 landscape, of a cozy coffee table set for a craft night: blank printed cards and name tags (leave blank for overlay), a bowl of popcorn, a small cheese board, a plain teapot, unlabeled thread skeins in pink, green and blue, two blank unpainted needlepoint canvases, a vase of tulips. Warm evening lamp light, Cream #FBF6EE and Bow Pink #F4B6C2 tones. No people, no hands, no painted canvas designs, no text, no brand labels, no logos, no trademarked characters, no watermarks.

assembly: Reuse the journal's gingham tile, motif set and palette so both products look like one shop.
Run the super prompt. In Canva create US Letter portrait and landscape designs plus A4 portrait and landscape designs; add 0.25 in (6 mm) margin guides.
Build each piece once at its finished size, then tile it on the page per the AI layout with 0.5 pt dashed cut lines. Print one test page of each at 100% scale and check sizes with a ruler.

Make the invitation, menu and table sign editable: Share > Template link (check that your Canva plan offers it and that every element is licensed for sharing), and paste the links into a 1-page 'Edit your kit' PDF.
Export two PDF Print files (Letter set, A4 set) plus the template-link PDF; keep each under 20 MB.
Listing images at least 2000 px wide: hero mockup with your pieces placed on the blank cards, swap tickets close-up, name tags, a 'what's included' grid with sizes.
List on Etsy at $6 and cross-link with the needlepoint journal.
